name: io.github.flumpiey/manager-mcp
title: Manager.io MCP
description: MCP server for Manager.io bookkeeping: read-first with opt-in scoped task and write tools

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Manager API base URL (include /api2 when required)

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access token from Manager Settings (sent as X-API-KEY)

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated delete scopes (never implied by write scopes)
